scope: Only the two named round5 authoring/M1 screenshots were actually viewed for this final review; round5 M3 and M4 screenshots were not reviewed here.

reported_test_context.source: Parent task report, separate from visual observations

observations: The task is paused and the saved supplement is explicitly marked not yet adopted.
The paid-task card shows 907 points already consumed and an available balance of 9093 points; the sidebar also shows 9093.
The quote section explicitly shows a total additional 4500 points and the confirmation button to add 4500 points and continue.
The additional-price explanation and consent action are legible, with no visible control overlap, clipping or horizontal overflow in this desktop image.
The task states that the document has been generated and can be downloaded.
The paid-task card shows 4500 points charged for this execution and an available balance of 4593 points; the sidebar also shows 4593.
The adopted supplement summary explicitly records the additional 4500 points.
The current result is labelled version 2; clean and tracked downloads are distinct, and the clean download shows the browser-download handoff message.
The current update note visibly includes a SYNTHETIC_AUTHORING_..._ADOPTED material marker.
No visible control overlap, clipping or horizontal overflow was seen, including around the material marker text.

observed_conclusion: The paid point display, explicit additional-4500 consent, adopted state and version-2 download state remain visually understandable at the recorded desktop viewport, without obvious layout obstruction.

product_assets_at_round5_start.basis: Associated with the frozen product assets recorded at round5 start; this visual review does not itself assert final before/after source stability for the whole test run.

limitations: The quotation section remains low on a long page and requires scrolling from the initial desktop viewport.
This final visual review covers round5 M1 only. It does not replace the earlier round2 M1/M4 review or claim review of final M3/M4 screenshots.
